name: chronoflow
description: Todo app and time tracker with Jira integration

scripts.dev: concurrently -k --handle-input -n main,renderer "npm run dev:main" "npm run dev:renderer"
scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer

releaseInfo.releaseNotes:
### ChronoFlow v0.1.11

#### New Features:
- **Update notification toast:** a dismissible toast now pops up automatically whenever an update is available — and again once it is downloaded, with a Restart & Install button. No more digging into Settings to notice updates; it reappears on every launch and for new versions.
- **New app icon:** the TimeTracker sidebar logo (rounded gradient square with a clock) is now used as the app icon — taskbar, window, installer and shortcuts.

#### Fixes:
- **Timer times stored in UTC instead of local time:** starting the timer at 09:03 showed a start time of 07:03 (a 2-hour offset). Timer start/end times, manual entries, 15-minute rounding and idle-time assignment now all use local wall-clock time, matching the rest of the app including Jira worklog sync.
- **Editing a running entry's start time now updates the timer:** the running timer is recalibrated so the elapsed time matches the new start time, also when it starts before midnight.
